title: Cultural variation in correspondence bias: The critical role of attitude diagnosticity of socially constrained behavior
central_claims: Attitude diagnosticity moderates cultural differences in correspondence bias: Americans maintain bias for nondiagnostic constrained behavior, whereas Japanese participants attenuate it.
